text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

words.gloss_range: coordinating and resumptive particle linking this relative profile to the surrounding believer portrait
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens 42:38 as continuation, not as a disconnected start. It attaches the new relative description to the prior moral portrait, so response, prayer, consultation, and spending accumulate with what came before. The particle does not govern case itself; its payoff is structural, carrying the same portrait across a clause boundary.

topics.headline: coordinated relative profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the following four traits belong to the same descriptive chain rather than launching a separate subject.
topics.reason: QAC marks a prefixed conjunction before the relative pronoun, and attachment evidence treats the following clauses as coordinated attributes.

topics.headline: boundary continuation from the prior portrait
topics.reader_payoff: The reader carries the previous moral portrait into this ayah, so forgiveness, response, worship, counsel, and spending read cumulatively.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL boundary rows identify continuation across 42:37 to 42:38, and no syntactic evidence forces a hard new subject.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun holding one communal antecedent across all coordinated predicates and suffixes
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) keeps the identity open until the whole profile is complete. The same plural group answers, establishes prayer, has its affair defined by consultation, receives provision, and spends. Because the relative pronoun is plural and class-forming, the ayah describes a communal identity by conduct rather than naming an office, lineage, or isolated virtue.

topics.headline: one group through all predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no single trait exhausts the group; one antecedent carries the whole sequence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence repeatedly routes the same relative pronoun as subject or suffix referent through the coordinated clauses.

topics.headline: conduct-defined communal class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah forming a corporate moral identity from response, worship, governance, receipt, and expenditure.
topics.reason: The masculine plural relative form and repeated third-person plural links support a collective class profile.

topics.headline: same portrait across the ayah boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not split 42:38 from the preceding believer description; it continues the same moral subject.
topics.reason: The boundary rows preserve continuity, and the syntax supplies no new named subject.

words.gloss_range: Form X perfect response, locally oriented by the following lām phrase toward the Lord
words.root_gloss_range: answering, responding, practical compliance, and passage-opening imagery; local grammar selects favorable Lordward response
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟}} ({{tr:istajābū}}) is the first finite predicate, so the whole profile begins as response before it becomes worship, counsel, or spending. The following lām phrase makes the response Lordward rather than a bare reply, and the perfect presents it as a settled uptake already embodied by the group. Form X and the {{ar:ج و ب}} ({{tr:j-w-b}}) passage image make the response feel like receptive self-opening; 8:24 commands such response, 42:38 describes a community already marked by it, and 42:47 later returns the same root as renewed summons.

topics.headline: response directed by the lām complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response is defined by Lordward orientation, not by an unnamed speech object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the lām-governed Lord phrase the complement of the response verb.

topics.headline: settled response governs the trait list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prayer, consultation, and spending as expressions of a response already taken up.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect and first in the relative predicate sequence, with the same pro-drop subject controlled by the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: Form X receptive opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels response as favorable self-opening to a summons, not as a clipped verbal answer.
topics.reason: The local Form X verb and root-family rows support receptive compliance while local grammar blocks unrelated root branches from taking over.

topics.headline: commanded response becomes embodied description
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare commanded response elsewhere with this achieved communal response, especially 8:24 and 42:47.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete references including 2:186, 8:24, and 42:47; these work as parallels without controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: bound lām marking the genitive Lord phrase as the directed complement of response
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the small hinge that turns response toward relation. It governs the following Lord noun and binds it to the response verb, so the response is both to the Lord as addressee and for Him as purpose. Because it is prefixed, direction and possessed authority arrive as one compact unit.

topics.headline: lām binds response to its Lordward complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response is relationally directed rather than left as generic obedience.
topics.reason: The attachment table marks the following noun as a lām-governed complement of the response verb.

topics.headline: direction and devotion coincide
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears one particle carry both address and devoted purpose.
topics.reason: The semantic range of the lām is locally licensed by the response frame and its governed Lord phrase.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct noun with third-person plural suffix, naming the group's own sustaining Lord as response complement
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, mastery, ownership, nurture, governance, and sustaining care; local response and provision links keep both authority and care active
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) makes the response personal and communal: the Lord is theirs, and the suffix begins a chain that later reaches their affair, their internal space, and their received provision. The root {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) keeps authority joined to sustaining care, so the one answered at the opening is also the provider behind the closing expenditure. The contrast with universal lordship in 1:2 helps the local form stand out: cosmic Lordship is narrowed here into the community's own relation.

topics.headline: their Lord as the first possessed relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that communal identity is first framed by belonging to the Lord before any social practice is named.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive through the preceding lām and definite through the attached plural suffix.

topics.headline: lordship as authority and care
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees obedience as answer to an authority who also sustains and provides, not to bare command alone.
topics.reason: The root field supports authority and nurture, while the ayah's later provision verb selects the sustaining side without erasing command.

topics.headline: same group from belonging to receipt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one group from Lord-relation through governance into received provision and spending.
topics.reason: Repeated third-person plural suffixes and the first-person provision verb create a local arc from relation to receipt to outflow.

topics.headline: universal lordship localized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 1:2 with this phrase and see cosmic Lordship made local to this responding community.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply 1:2 as contrast; the local suffix keeps the comparison anchored to this form.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining the prayer-establishment verb to the prior perfect response without forcing chronology
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the second perfect verb to the first. It lets prayer stand beside response as a settled trait of the same group, not as a separate sentence or a necessarily later stage. By keeping two perfect verbal predicates parallel, it also prepares the next shift into the nominal consultation clause.

topics.headline: prayer added to settled response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees response and prayer as coordinated settled commitments of one subject.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second perfect verb with the first and keeps the same relative subject.

topics.headline: verbal rhythm before nominal pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the first two actions grouped before the ayah slows into standing governance.
topics.reason: The bound conjunction carries the subject forward and marks a parallel pair before the following nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect transitive verb meaning they established or maintained the prayer as an upheld practice
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, straightness, persistence, maintenance, communal body; local Form IV with prayer object selects causative establishment
words.prose: {{ar:أَقَامُوا۟}} ({{tr:aqāmū}}) takes prayer as its direct object, so the root's standing range becomes causative establishment: the group causes a known practice to stand. Its perfect aspect matches the prior response as a settled commitment, while the {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) field lets worship feel upright, maintained, and socially ordering, preparing the move toward the community's affair. The establishment-prayer formula appears as command in places such as 2:43; here it has become a trait already carried by the community.

topics.headline: Form IV causes prayer to stand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prayer as an upheld institution, not a momentary devotional act.
topics.reason: The verb is Form IV and transitive with the definite prayer noun as direct object.

topics.headline: second perfect completes the opening pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees response and established prayer grouped before the central governance clause.
topics.reason: The perfect verb shares the relative subject and closes the opening action panel.

topics.headline: standing becomes upright maintenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels established worship preparing the move from bodily uprightness to ordered communal affair.
topics.reason: The root-family rows support standing, straightness, maintenance, and communal-body pressure, narrowed by the local object.

topics.headline: formulaic prayer command as achieved profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare commanded prayer establishment in 2:43 with the achieved profile here.
topics.reason: The rows supply the establishment-prayer formula and concrete reference 2:43, while local grammar makes it descriptive rather than imperative.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative verbal noun naming the recognized prayer practice as the object established
words.root_gloss_range: formal prayer, invocation, blessing, relation, and debated fervor-nearness pressure; local establishment selects the ritual institution
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣalāta}}) is definite and accusative, so the object is the known prayer practice made to stand by the preceding verb. As a verbal noun, it lets an act become a maintained institution. The {{ar:ص ل و}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-w}}) field is locally narrowed to formal prayer, while the supplied root dispute keeps relational and fervent pressure in the background. After the avoided indecency field in 42:37, 29:45 makes prayer's restraining role a useful parallel, but here the word also bridges Lordward response into communal governance. The assimilated article makes its knownness audible as it merges into the prayer noun.

topics.headline: known prayer as upheld object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prayer as the recognized institution being upheld, not an indefinite devotional utterance.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the noun as definite accusative direct object of the establishment verb.

topics.headline: ritual practice with relational intensity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that establishment selects formal prayer while preserving prayer as a maintained relation, not a bare rite label.
topics.reason: The establishment verb selects the ritual-prayer sense; the root-dispute material survives only as pressure around relation and intensity.

topics.headline: prayer between response and governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prayer discipline the responsive community before its social affair appears.
topics.reason: The rows tie prayer to the preceding moral field and to the local sequence from Lord-response into communal affair.

topics.headline: formulaic prayer language made audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the known prayer formula as a marked, definite object in a broader ethical list.
topics.reason: The formulaic rows and sun-letter assimilation row add local payoff without changing the grammatical object relation.

words.gloss_range: conjunction introducing a coordinated nominal clause and pivoting from completed acts to standing social predication
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces a new nominal clause rather than another object of the prayer verb. The particle adds consultation to the same relative profile while making the structural turn visible: after two perfect actions, the ayah slows into a standing predicate about communal affairs.

topics.headline: new nominal clause under the same profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the governance clause is coordinated, not subordinated to prayer-establishment.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the following unit as a coordinated nominal clause.

topics.headline: pivot from actions to standing mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels consultation introduced as an abiding social mode rather than a third completed action.
topics.reason: The conjunction sits at the transition from perfect verbal predicates into an equational nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: nominative construct subject with plural suffix, naming their actionable affair or authority-domain before the consultation predicate
words.root_gloss_range: command, affair, decision, authority, matter, and outcome; local predicate narrows the field into communal business handled by consultation
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:amruhum}}) is the subject of a verbless clause, so consultation defines the affair instead of merely advising it from outside. The suffix makes the matter theirs, but the predicate immediately prevents possession from becoming unilateral control. The {{ar:أ م ر}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-r}}) range includes command, decision, authority, and business; in 42:38 that force is disciplined into shared deliberative responsibility. The link with 3:159 is sharp: there consultation is commanded in the affair, while here the affair itself is consultation.

topics.headline: their affair defined by the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consultation is not an optional add-on; it identifies the community's affair.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks this noun as the subject of a nominal predication whose predicate is consultation.

topics.headline: command-field converted into shared responsibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees authority remain real but become accountable to counsel rather than private command.
topics.reason: The root range supports authority and affair, while the immediate consultation predicate narrows how that authority functions.

topics.headline: one shared domain of public business
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees many possible matters compressed into one communal domain owned by the group.
topics.reason: The singular construct with attached plural suffix binds the affair to the group without pluralizing it into scattered matters.

topics.headline: command to consult becomes communal identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares 3:159 with 42:38 and sees consultation move from instruction into the community's standing mode.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply 3:159 and same-surah authority contrasts; these clarify the local predicate relation.

words.gloss_range: indefinite abstract predicate naming consultation as the standing mode or quality of their affair
words.root_gloss_range: consulting, advising, pointing out, seeking counsel, and extracting value; local predication selects mutual deliberative counsel
words.prose: {{ar:شُورَىٰ}} ({{tr:shūrā}}) is the predicate of their affair, so consultation is what the affair is, not merely an event beside it. Its indefinite abstract form names a quality or mode rather than one formal council. The {{ar:ش و ر}} ({{tr:sh-w-r}}) field, with its counsel-seeking and value-extraction imagery, makes deliberation a process of drawing out judgment from within the group. Because the exact root is rare, this central predicate carries marked weight, and its long vowels make the center of the clause linger before the phrase closes. 3:159 gives a useful contrast, where consultation is commanded, while here it becomes the community's public identity.

topics.headline: consultation as identity of the affair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consultation is a standing predicate, not an occasional procedure.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks this word as the predicate of the possessed affair in a nominal clause.

topics.headline: counsel as drawn-out value
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees counsel as eliciting valuable judgment among participants, not merely collecting opinions.
topics.reason: The root-family rows support extraction, mutual consultation, and seeking counsel; the local phrase selects deliberative consultation.

topics.headline: affair, counsel, and internal space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the governance mechanism formed by a possessed affair, a counsel predicate, and the internal field among them.
topics.reason: The predicate is completed by the following adverbial, creating a local governance triad.

topics.headline: rare consultation root carries marked weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the marked lexical choice and the contrast between consultation commanded in 3:159 and identity-predicated here.
topics.reason: The rows identify the root as rare and give 3:159 as a concrete comparison.

topics.headline: central predicate lingers audibly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the central consultation word linger in the phrase rather than pass as a light connector.
topics.reason: The sound and exact-noun rows reinforce the central nominal predicate without altering its syntax.

words.gloss_range: adverbial relational noun with plural suffix locating consultation within the group's own mutual field
words.root_gloss_range: between-ness, separation, distinction, clarification, evidence, and relational space; local adverbial selects the internal field among the community
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَهُمْ}} ({{tr:baynahum}}) closes the consultation phrase by locating it among the same group. The suffix prevents the counsel from being externally imposed or abstract; the field is their internal accountable space. The {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}) range joins separation and clarification, so distinct participants are not erased by consultation; their between-ness becomes the place where matters can become clear. In 2:213, between-ness is a field of judgment among people; here it is turned inward as deliberation before communal action.

topics.headline: consultation located among them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consultation happens inside the community's own accountable field, not above it or outside it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks this word as the adverbial completing the consultation predicate.

topics.headline: same plural group in the mutual space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same community through Lord-relation, affair, mutual space, and provision.
topics.reason: The attached plural suffix resumes the same relative antecedent tracked across the ayah.

topics.headline: separation becomes clarifying space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees mutual distinction as the space where counsel can clarify rather than as a problem to erase.
topics.reason: The root rows support both interval and clarification, narrowed by the local adverbial relation.

topics.headline: between-space shifted from judgment to counsel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares 2:213 with 42:38 and sees the between-space move from adjudication to constructive deliberation.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide 2:213 and same-surah relation-management contrasts as concrete parallels.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the final source-provision-spending clause with the preceding communal profile
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than attach to the next preposition; it coordinates the whole final spending clause. After the nominal stillness of consultation, the connector reopens verbal action and carries the profile from internal governance into outward expenditure. Because it is bound to the fronted source phrase, the transition into spending begins with received provision before the human act is named.

topics.headline: final spending unit coordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spending as the next complete trait in the same profile, not as an isolated phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the final expenditure clause as coordinated with the relative profile.

topics.headline: consultation opens into expenditure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that internal counsel does not close the profile; it leads into practical provision-outflow.
topics.reason: The connector is prefixed to the fronted source phrase and resumes action after the nominal consultation clause.

words.gloss_range: contracted source and relative phrase, fronted before the spending verb to frame expenditure by what was provided

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source or partitive element represented inside the fused surface {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}})
open relative or indefinite element represented inside the fused surface {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}})

words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) places the source before the spending verb, so the clause begins with received provision rather than human generosity. The contracted form joins source or partitive {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) with open {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), letting the phrase mean from what, or from whatever, God has supplied, while the repeated m sound tightens the source phrase before provision is specified. This fronting makes spending look like stewardship from an allotted pool: source, provision, and then outflow.

topics.headline: source processed before the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision frames expenditure before the spending act appears.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the phrase as the fronted source complement of the spending verb.

topics.headline: from some of what was supplied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spending as managed outflow from divine supply, not total disposal or self-originated wealth.
topics.reason: The fused source phrase contains both source or partitive force and an open relative element completed by the provision verb.

topics.headline: contracted source marker tightens the phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source phrase tightened into one compact unit before provision is specified.
topics.reason: The contraction and sound rows reinforce the fronted source unit without changing its syntactic role.

topics.headline: source, provision, then outflow
topics.reader_payoff: The reader processes the final clause as routed stewardship rather than a spending verb alone.
topics.reason: Word order and the relative provision clause force source and divine supply before the human expenditure verb.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect relative-clause verb with first-person plural subject and third-person plural object, defining the provision pool
words.root_gloss_range: provision, livelihood, allotted benefit, supply, provider-recipient relation, and seeking provision; local Form I selects direct divine supplying
words.prose: {{ar:رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:razaqnāhum}}) completes the open source phrase by naming the pool from which spending happens. The perfect places provision before the ongoing expenditure, and the verb packs giver and recipients into one form: the divine speaker provides, while the same community is object-recipient. The {{ar:ر ز ق}} ({{tr:r-z-q}}) range is narrowed here to received beneficial allotment, not self-originated possession. The phrase echoes the spending formula in 2:3, but 42:38 places it after consultation, making provisionary spending the outflow of a deliberative community.

topics.headline: perfect provision before ongoing spending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is spent has already been given before the spending verb arrives.
topics.reason: The verb is a perfect relative clause inside the fronted source phrase, defining the source before the expenditure verb.

topics.headline: giver and recipients packed into the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the community become recipients before it becomes spending agents.
topics.reason: The form contains first-person plural subject marking and a third-person plural object suffix tied to the same relative group.

topics.headline: provision before ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands resources as received beneficial allotment rather than absolute self-owned wealth.
topics.reason: The root range supports provision and recipienthood, while local Form I and the source phrase select direct divine supply.

topics.headline: piety formula specialized by consultation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares 2:3 with 42:38 and sees the familiar spending formula located after communal consultation.
topics.reason: The rows give the exact 2:3 formula and local links from Lord-response to provision and spending.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect plural verb for ongoing expenditure, source-framed by the fronted provision phrase
words.root_gloss_range: spending, causing outflow, support expenditure, passage, outlet, exhaustion, and hypocrisy in other branches; local source phrase selects expenditure while preserving passage imagery
words.prose: {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūn}}) closes the ayah with ongoing action. Its subject returns to the same relative group, and the plural ending audibly seals the ayah with that communal actor; its complement has already been fronted: they spend from what was provided. The {{ar:ن ف ق}} ({{tr:n-f-q}}) field includes passage and outflow, and Form IV makes the group cause resources to pass outward deliberately. Branches such as exhaustion or hypocrisy are blocked by the provision source, while the passage image survives as routed spending. The phrase completes the 2:3 formula in a new location after consultation, and 3:92 sharpens the contrast between spending beloved things and spending from supplied provision.

topics.headline: imperfect spending from provided source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah land on continuing expenditure whose source has already been defined as provision.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect and governed by the fronted source phrase, with the relative pronoun supplying its subject.

topics.headline: same plural actor closes the profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same communal subject close the ayah in active outflow.
topics.reason: Agreement and pro-drop subject evidence return the verb to the opening relative pronoun.

topics.headline: passage image narrowed to expenditure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spending as deliberate routed outflow, while unrelated branches are kept out of the local sense.
topics.reason: The fronted provision phrase selects expenditure; Form IV and the root field preserve the passage-through image without activating hypocrisy or exhaustion branches.

topics.headline: piety formula after consultation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares 2:3 and 3:92 with 42:38 and sees this spending framed by supplied provision and social consultation.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete formula and contrast references, with 42:38 locally specializing the formula after consultation.

topics.headline: opening response enacted as closing expenditure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Lordward response at the opening become concrete economic circulation at the close.
topics.reason: The final imperfect closes the coordinated profile by turning already named provision into ongoing outflow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of responding at word 2, establishing at words 4-5, consulting over their affair at words 6-8, and spending at word 11.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural subject receives an address, maintains a standing ritual order, processes its own affair by reciprocal opinion-extraction, and sends allotted provision outward. The clauses form one communal operating cycle rather than detached virtues.

activation_trace.role: Reply and response initiate the call-and-answer cycle.
Care, preservation, and governance make establishment ongoing maintenance.
Consulting and managing opinion place their affair inside deliberation.
Extracting opinion by mutual review supplies the decision process.
A connective relation among parties supplies the social topology.
An allotted gift supplies the material input.
Expenditure sends that input outward and completes circulation.

changed_reading.before: A list of prayer, consultation, and charity.
changed_reading.after: A responsive communal cycle: receive, maintain orientation, deliberate shared affairs, and circulate received means.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from consultation among them at words 6-8 to spending from provision at words 10-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: Consultation harvests concentrated judgment from dispersed participants while spending releases apportioned goods from their holders. The verse pairs an epistemic commons with a material commons.

activation_trace.role: Gathering honey supplies the exploratory image of harvesting concentrated value.
Extracting opinion by review converts that image into an epistemic process.
The interval among parties is the field from which distributed judgment is drawn.
A portioned benefit establishes material possession as a received share.
Expenditure converts the held share into common-facing benefit.

changed_reading.before: Consultation and spending are unrelated virtues.
changed_reading.after: They are parallel conversions of privately held value into shared judgment and shared benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Response at word 2, the between-space at word 8, and provision/outflow at words 10-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: An opening, an intermediate relational space, and a passage with an outlet compose a permeability model. Response opens the collective body; consultation moves meaning across it; spending keeps provision from terminating in possession.

activation_trace.role: An aperture gives response the exploratory role of opening the group to an address.
Extraction from a source images usable content drawn from within.
The middle interval supplies the interior exchange-space.
A through-passage with an outlet images spending as transmission rather than disappearance.

changed_reading.before: Response and spending are endpoints in a catalogue.
changed_reading.after: The verse sketches a permeable communal body whose openings, interior exchange, and outlets keep value moving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence contrasts plurality with an unrealized single community, names divergent paths and transgressive fracture, reserves final judgment to God, and commands justice between parties. Consultation becomes a bounded anti-fracture procedure: difference is processed without becoming domination.

activation_trace.role: Reviewed opinion supplies the procedure for processing plurality.
The connective relation between parties is what deliberation preserves.
Union in one direction supplies the unrealized contrast to governed plurality.
Parties taking different paths supply the conflict to be processed.
Judgment between people supplies the divine boundary on communal procedure.
Transgression beyond limits identifies what turns difference into fracture.
Justice in judgment and conduct supplies the criterion between parties.

structural_cues: 42:13 commands establishment without division; 42:14 locates transgressive division between the parties.
42:15 repeats the between-construction around justice, argument, and gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-forced plurality, divergent paths, divine judgment, transgressive fracture, and justice; I infer consultation as the human procedure keeping plurality from becoming domination. A live alternative is that consultation is only a communal descriptor.

changed_reading.before: Their consultation is a generally inclusive custom.
changed_reading.after: It is a justice-bounded method for carrying real plurality without coerced sameness, schism, or transgressive control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision elsewhere expands, contracts, and arrives by measure; unrestricted expansion is explicitly coupled to transgression. Focus expenditure becomes community-side metering that moves a received share without treating either abundance or depletion as good in itself.

activation_trace.role: An allotted benefit makes the resource a measured share.
Expenditure provides the human-controlled release from that share.
Depletion keeps release from becoming unqualified dissipation.
Expansion and abundance supply one pole of provision's range.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the opposite pole.
Transgression supplies the stated danger of unrestricted expansion.
A quantity reaching its proper limit supplies the controlling measure.

structural_cues: 42:27 places hypothetical abundance, transgression, and measured descent in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured provision and abundance-linked transgression; I infer focus expenditure as a counter-pressure that recirculates shares. The live alternative is generosity without an implied regulatory role.

changed_reading.before: They give away some of what they possess.
changed_reading.after: They steward measured inflow by controlled outflow, resisting both hoarded abundance and wasteful exhaustion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The response root appears with an already granted response, divine response followed by increase, the focus community's response, and a later imperative before an irreversible day. The focus identity becomes a temporal call-and-return circuit rather than a completed one-way act.

activation_trace.role: Response anchors the community inside the recurring relation.
A response already granted supplies an earlier completed turn.
Response toward believers supplies the returning turn.
Gift and beneficence make increase the surplus carried by return.
The imperative makes response an urgent repeated action.
Return to a prior place, here denied, closes the response window.

structural_cues: The response root occupies distinct grammatical positions at 42:16, 42:26, 42:38, and 42:47.
42:26 couples response with increase; 42:47 couples it with irreversibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root recurrence, changed direction, increase, and a deadline; I infer a reciprocal circuit open only for a time. A live alternative is that the occurrences are independent uses.

changed_reading.before: They once accepted their Lord's call.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit an ongoing response relation: answer, receive a returning increase, and answer again while return remains possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured provision is followed by rain descending after despair, mercy spreading, creatures being dispersed, and their possible gathering. Because the focus provision inventory itself includes rain, spending carries a contained ecological analogy: sustenance becomes life-bearing when released across the relational field.

activation_trace.role: Rain named as provision opens the focus resource to the ecological sequence.
Expenditure supplies the human-scale release.
Life-giving rain supplies the descending resource image.
Opening and spreading turn descent into distributed mercy.
Dispersal supplies outward multiplication across the field.
Gathering keeps distribution connected to eventual recomposition.

structural_cues: 42:27-29 runs from measured descent to rain, spreading mercy, dispersal, and gathering.
The focus places spending immediately after received provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain as a provision branch and a descent-spread-dispersal-gather sequence; I infer human expenditure as analogous life-bearing release. The live alternative is that the sequence supplies no social model.

changed_reading.before: Spending transfers resources from one holder to another.
changed_reading.after: Spending is provision made rain-like: released between people so received mercy can propagate life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is bracketed by forgiving when angry and vindicating oneself when transgression strikes; the next ayat authorize equivalence while preferring pardon, repair, patience, and forgiveness. Consultation becomes the collective calibration hinge among live responses.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative management makes response to injury a shared affair.
Reviewed judgment supplies the calibration procedure.
Covering wrongdoing and protecting its bearer supplies immediate restraint.
Aggression beyond bounds supplies the injury that can legitimate resistance.
The wronged party's vindication supplies the active-response option.
Matching by equivalence supplies proportionality's ceiling.
Leaving punishment supplies a non-retaliatory option.
Removing estrangement makes pardon answerable to repair.
Holding the self back supplies durable restraint.
Heart-bound resolve marks forgiveness as deliberate strength.

structural_cues: 42:37-39 are consecutive members of the repeated plural-relative description.
42:38 stands between forgiveness under anger and self-vindication under aggression; 42:40-43 specify the options and limits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bracketing options and their limits; I infer consultation as the procedure by which a community calibrates response. The live alternative is that these virtues remain independent.

changed_reading.before: Consultation is a standing trait beside anger-control and defense.
changed_reading.after: It is the decision point that keeps defense proportionate and makes forgiveness a reasoned, reparative choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending distinguishes delivery from custodial control and depicts mediated divine communication, then names revelation as spirit from the divine affair, light, and guidance. Normative orientation and local procedure are separated: revelation supplies direction while their affair remains theirs to process by consultation.

activation_trace.role: Their affair marks the sphere of situated communal responsibility.
Mutual extraction of opinion supplies the local procedure.
Custodial guarding, negated here, withholds coercive management from the messenger.
Delivery of the message supplies the positive limit of that role.
Knowledge cast in hidden fashion supplies mediated orientation.
A screening barrier makes mediation explicit.
The divine affair supplies the orienting source-domain, distinct from their affair.
Illumination supplies intelligible orientation.
Gentle indication toward the path directs without replacing deliberative agency.

structural_cues: 42:48 negates prophetic custodianship and restricts the task to delivery.
42:51-52 moves through mediated communication to spirit from the divine affair, light, and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-custodial delivery, mediated revelation, and orienting light; I infer a division between revealed norm and consultative local agency. The live alternative is that these ayat imply no distribution of decision authority.

changed_reading.before: Consultation is either autonomous rule-making or execution of externally settled commands.
changed_reading.after: Their affair carries genuine responsibility under revealed orientation: guidance bounds the field without erasing communal judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it activates the non-dominant mapped j-b-y inventory beneath focus j-w-b; valid because the packet explicitly maps the focus root to root_000220 and 42:13 realizes that branch. Render only as a secondary gathering/selection image around response, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The responding plural subject at word 2 and its shared consultation at word 7.

activation_trace.role: Selection and approach give response a branch-distant image of being drawn into a cohort.
The same branch appears contextually as selection and approach, activating rather than inventing the image.
Mutual opinion-extraction shows how the gathered cohort acts without collapsing into one voice.

changed_reading.before: The subject is a pre-existing group distinguished by having answered.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, answering images formation of a gathered or selected cohort whose plurality becomes operative through consultation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because a contextual s-k-n branch names stabilizing a ship by its rudder although the surface clause stills wind; valid because establishing and consultation anchor it while 42:32-33 supplies navigation, wind, stasis, and the packet's rudder branch. Render as a qualified systems analogy, not a lexical meaning of consultation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Establishing at word 4 and consultation at word 7.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and balance supply the maintained course.
Reviewed opinion supplies steering input.
Stabilizing a ship by its rudder activates the qualified steering image.
Wind supplies changing motive force.
Stasis after motion supplies the failure mode when force disappears.

changed_reading.before: Consultation aggregates views after affairs arise.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, consultation is the rudder keeping a shared affair balanced and directed as conditions change.

strongest_changes: The 42:37-43 sequence makes consultation the calibration hinge between forgiveness, proportionate defense, repair, and restraint.
The expansion-measure-transgression sequence changes spending into stewardship of regulated circulation.
Repeated response forms place the community in a time-bounded reciprocal call-and-return relation.
The closing delivery/revelation sequence distinguishes revealed orientation from responsibility for their own affair.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made 42:38 a hinge rather than a catalogue: response recurs across changing directions, provision sits inside measured ecological circulation, and consultation is bracketed by forgiveness and resistance to aggression.
remaining_uncertainties: Consultation as the procedure for choosing among defense, pardon, and repair is inferred from placement.
The reciprocal circuit reads changing grammatical uses of the response root together rather than independently.
The rain, gathered-selection, permeability, and rudder models are branch-backed analogies, not replacement translations.
The packet does not force a precise boundary for the scope of their affair.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Response becomes an upright communal circuit.** Lexical evidence: ج و ب `B003` (responding), ق و م `B008` (uprightness), ص ل و `B003` (prescribed worship) and `B006` (following a leader in second place), and ب ي ن `B003` (tie between parties). Structural cue and role: response to the nurturer passes into established prayer and then shared affairs. Abductive move: I infer that ritual alignment trains a non-isolated mode of coordinated standing. Reading change: the list is a connected social mechanism, not four detached virtues.

2. **Consultation draws counsel out as honey is drawn, while provision exits into circulation.** Lexical evidence: ش و ر `B002` (drawing honey) and `B003` (drawing out counsel), ر ز ق `B001` (allotted gift), and ن ف ق `B002` (wealth going out as expenditure) with `B003` (tunnel with an exit). Structural cue and role: **شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ** extracts distributed judgment; **يُنفِقُونَ** then moves received material outward. Abductive move: I infer a parallel circulation: insight is drawn from persons and provision is released from holdings. Reading change: communal order depends on preventing both counsel and wealth from remaining sealed inside individuals.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:47 repeats the response imperative at an ultimate temporal boundary, showing that the communal response here trains the same capacity to answer before closure. No later ayah displaced the consultation–circulation mechanism.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Consultation draws usable judgment from a collective as honey is drawn from a hive.** **Lexical evidence:** ش و ر `B002` (drawing honey from its hive), activated beneath شُورَىٰ alongside `B003` (drawing out counsel through consultation), and ب ي ن `B003` (tie between parties). **Structural cue:** 42:35 showed twisted disputation; the fixed ayah locates counsel between participants; 42:39-42 then pose the hard cases of defense, equivalent response, pardon, and liability. **Assigned role:** the honey branch models deliberation as extracting a beneficial product from distributed contributions. **Abductive move:** I infer a material analogy, not an etymological identity of counsel with honey. **Reading change:** consultation becomes a disciplined extraction process whose output must serve the connected group, not a recital of private preferences.
2. **Inbound response is paired with outbound provision.** **Lexical evidence:** ج و ب `B003` (responsive compliance), ر ز ق `B001` (allotted provision), and ن ف ق `B002` (wealth going out as expenditure), anchored in ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ ... رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ. **Structural cue:** response opens the sequence and expenditure closes it, with prayer and counsel mediating between. **Assigned role:** the community receives directive and provision, stabilizes them ritually and deliberatively, then sends provision outward. **Abductive move:** I infer a circulation mechanism from the clause order. **Reading change:** communal response is completed only when received provision exits toward others.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:39-42 made the honey-drawing branch operational by supplying the community's difficult deliberative material: harm, equivalence, pardon, and legitimate claim. 42:43's firm resolve then showed that counsel must eventually yield a stable course.

baseline.text: Rablerinin çağrısına karşılık verir, namazı kılarlar. İşlerini aralarında danışarak yürütürler ve kendilerine verdiğimiz rızıktan harcarlar.

findings.text: Danışma, kovandan bal çıkarır gibi topluluğun dağınık katkılarından herkesin kullanabileceği bir hüküm çıkaran disiplinli süreçtir.
Topluluk Rabbinin çağrısını içeri alır, bunu ibadet ve danışmayla düzenler, sonra kendisine ulaşan rızkı dışarıya aktarır; karşılık verme dolaşımla tamamlanır.

inter_ayah_rows.note: It closely joins established prayer and spending from provision, adding patient pursuit of the Lord and repelling wrong with good.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explains the focus's outgoing spending as provision that God can replenish within His widening and measuring of sustenance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It again joins prayer and spending from provision, while adding night devotion, fear, and hope.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It gives the concise believer formula of faith in the unseen, established prayer, and spending from received provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its warning that none can escape God or find another protector does not develop the focus's communal practices.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Teaching expression supplies a distant condition for deliberation, but does not itself describe consultation or the focus's other acts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Recitation, prayer, and secret and open spending present the focus's practices as a lived, durable course.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediately preceding contrast between fleeting possessions and what endures with God frames the believers described in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Divine clarification is only an indirect counterpart to the discernment needed for communal consultation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats the paired practices of establishing prayer and spending from provision, though without response or consultation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its contrast between incapacity and a person who spends granted provision specifies active, secret and public circulation of resources.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its reference to what lies between heaven and earth gives only a remote analogue to the focus's relational between-them language.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats prayer and spending from provision within a fuller pattern of reverence, patience, and humility.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The nearby statement about disputants having no escape does not clarify response, consultation, prayer, or spending.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It closely repeats prayer and spending from provision, adding urgency before a day when exchange and friendship cannot avail.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Answering God and the Messenger after injury directly illuminates the focus's responsive community as resilient action.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its account of earned affliction and extensive pardon supplies the immediate ethical setting for the qualities listed in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly makes a family decision depend on mutual consent and consultation while regulating provision and preventing harm.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins faith, righteous action, prayer, and almsgiving, giving a broad parallel to the focus's worship and material support.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A rival party's firmly settled affair is only a contrastive endpoint to the focus's deliberative handling of communal affairs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Lord's response to those who call on Him supplies a reciprocal-response counterpart, though not the focus's communal sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly contrasts those who answer their Lord with those who refuse, making response to the Lord decisive.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The preceding praise of avoiding grave wrongs and forgiving anger supplies the moral disposition of the same community.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It asks why people would not believe and spend from God's provision, but lacks the focus's prayer and consultation structure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 Impact, Matched Redress, and Repair (42:30-43)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Harm travels from deed to impact, may be answered proportionally, and can finally be interrupted by pardon and repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Moral consequence is staged as a projectile hitting its target, a wound exceeding its boundary, a matched counterstroke, and a footprint that can still be erased.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Erasure and Repair
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The chain of matching injury is stopped by erasing its trace, covering exposure, and repairing the relation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: pardon as erasure `quranic:root_001032:B001/m01`; wind removing a footprint `quranic:root_001032:B006/m01`; practical repair `quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`; reconciliation `quranic:root_000876:B002/m01`; nurturing repair toward completion `quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`; protective covering `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Pardon does more than decline a counterstroke: it removes the track by which injury would continue to be followed. Repair and reconciliation then fill the cleared space with a restored relation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A community remains ordered by drawing judgment inward from its members and sending material support outward among them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Consultation is pictured as harvesting a substance from a collective, while expenditure becomes the outward circulation that sustains the same body.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyi delip geçecek biçimde kesmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir; kaya oyma, yer kazma, giysi açıklığı açma ve boynuzun deriyi yararak çıkması bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu işlem ve sonuç ilişkisini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, nesnede geçişli bir yarma veya kesme işlemiyle sınırlıdır; yer aşma, sözlü karşılık ve yalnızca oluşmuş boşluk bu çekirdeğe girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel delip kesme çekirdeğini, belirli yapılara bağlı giysi, kazma ve boynuz örneklerinden ayırır; bu özel kullanımlar yalın anlamın tamamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yarıp öte yanına geçecek biçimde kesmek veya delmek; kaya oyma ve yer kazma bunun sert yüzey ya da zemin üzerindeki özel gerçekleşmeleridir. Giyside açıklık oluşturma ile boynuzun deriyi yararak dışarı çıkması da aynı geçişli yarılma düzenine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi, içinde geçişli bir açıklık oluşacak biçimde yarma, delme veya kesme işlemi.
Kayayı oyarak kesme ya da bir yeri kazıp çukurlaştırma, çekirdek işlemin sert yüzey ve zemin üzerindeki özel biçimleridir.
Giyside yaka açıklığı açmak ve boynuzun deriyi delerek çıkması, geçişli yarılmanın somut örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı delme ile kesmeyi tek bir geçişli işlemde birleştirir; giysi biçme, kaya oyma, kazma ve deriyi yararak çıkma bu işlemin farklı nesnelerdeki görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın tüm özel gerçekleşmelerini yöneten geçişli yarma ve kesme çekirdeği için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem kesme işlemini hem de açıklığın öte yana geçmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaya ya da zemin üzerinde oyma ve kazma yoluyla açıklık oluşturulan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sert bir yüzeyde keserek veya kazarak açıklık oluşturmayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Giysi kesme ve deriyi yararak çıkma gibi öteki gerçekleşmeleri dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Boynuz gibi bir parçanın deriyi delerek dışarı çıktığı bağlam için doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir engeli yararak öte yana çıkma düzenini korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan eliyle yapılan kesme, oyma ve kazma kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi ayırmaya yönelik kesme işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kesmenin geçişli bir delik veya açıklık oluşturması koşulunu siler.
error_profile.collision: Her türlü yüzeysel veya bütünüyle ayıran kesme için de kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Nesnede öte yana geçen bir açıklık oluşturmayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynağın açıkça taşıdığı kesme ve oyma işlemlerini tek başına belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı yer, ıssız alan, ülke ve geceyi baştan başa geçme hareketini; ayrıca bir ülkeden ötekine taşınan haberi aynı yol aşma düzeninde toplar. Sağlanan çerçeve hareket eden kişi ile taşınan haber arasındaki katılımcı değişimini de korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir alanı yol alarak aşmaktır; nesneyi fiziksel olarak delip kesme ve sözlü karşılık verme bu dala alınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel yer aşma kullanımı, gece boyunca ilerleme ve haberin ülkeler arasında taşınması gibi yapıya bağlı uzantılardan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yeri, ülkeyi ya da karanlık bir zaman aralığını yol alarak baştan başa geçmek. Aynı hareket düzeni, bir haberin uzak yerler arasında taşınmasına aktarılarak kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir yeri veya ülkeyi yol alıp bir ucundan öteki ucuna geçerek aşma.
Bütün gece ilerlemek veya karanlığı yararak yol almak, alan aşma çekirdeğinin zamansal ve görsel olarak belirlenmiş biçimidir.
Haberin bir ülkeden ötekine taşınması, yol aşan kişinin hareketinin taşınan bilgiye aktarılmış uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yer ve ülke aşmayı ortak çekirdek olarak sunar; sürekli yol alan kişi, gece boyunca ilerleme ve uzak yerlerden taşınan haber bu çekirdeğin katılımcı ya da kapsam uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı söze veya soruya karşılık verme, karşılıklı konuşma, çağrıya yönelme ve isteği yerine getirme kullanımlarını açıkça birlikte sunar. Dal çerçevesi yalnız söylenen cevabı değil, çağrıya kabul ve uyma yoluyla verilen karşılığı da kapsadığı için kaynağa uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği bir söz, soru, çağrı veya isteğe yöneltilmiş karşılıktır; yer aşma ve fiziksel kesme bu ilişkinin parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel karşılık verme çekirdeği, karşılıklı konuşma, çağrıya uyma ve yanlış işitmeye bağlı kalıplaşmış örneklerden ayrı katmanlarda tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir söze, soruya, çağrıya veya isteğe sözle ya da uygun eylemle karşılık vermek. Karşılıklı söz alışverişi bu işlemin iki yönlü biçimi, bir çağrıya uyma veya isteği yerine getirme ise eylemle gerçekleşen biçimidir.

facets.statement: Önceden yöneltilmiş bir söz veya soruya karşı söz üreterek karşılık verme.
Bir çağrıya yönelmek, ona uymak veya isteyenin dileğini yerine getirmek, karşılığın eylemle verilmiş uzantısıdır.
İki tarafın birbirine karşılık vererek konuşması, tek yönlü karşılığın karşılıklı konuşmaya genişlemiş biçimidir.
Yanlış işitmenin yanlış karşılığa yol açtığını anlatan kalıplaşmış söz, çekirdek ilişkinin sonuç bildiren bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılığı sözle verme ile çağrıya veya isteğe eylemle karşılık vermeyi aynı alanda toplar; karşılıklı konuşma iki tarafın art arda karşılık üretmesi olarak sunulur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı yerdeki çukur veya açık alanı, bulut ve dağlardaki aralığı, ortası boş nesneyi ve açılıp genişleyen oluşumu birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bunların ortak sonucu olan açılmış ya da içi boşalmış alanı doğru biçimde yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal oluşmuş açıklık, geniş boşluk veya ortası boş durumla ilgilidir; bu sonucu doğuran kesme işlemi ve yalnızca bir yerde ilerleme ayrı kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın açıklık ve boşluk çekirdeğinde kalır; belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı ek bir okuma içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yerde, dağda, bulutta veya bir nesnenin ortasında açılmış, genişlemiş ya da boş kalmış alan. Bulutun açılması bu boşluğun oluşma sürecini, ortası oyuk nesne ise kalıcı sonucunu gösterir.

facets.statement: Bir yüzeyde veya iki bölüm arasında açılmış ve genişlemiş boşluk, aralık ya da çukur alan.
Yerdeki çukur alan ile bulut veya dağ arasındaki açıklık, çekirdeğin çevresel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Bir nesnenin ortasının boş veya oyuk olması, alansal açıklığın nesne yapısına uygulanmış uzantısıdır.
Bulutun açılıp dağılması, kapalı görünüm içinde bir açıklığın ortaya çıkma sürecidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yerdeki çukur alanı, bulut ve dağdaki aralığı ve ortası boş nesneyi genişlemiş açıklık ortaklığında birleştirir; bulutun dağılması bu açıklığın oluşmasını anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı kadınların giydiği bir zırh veya giysiyi, kalkanı, kesilmiş bir üstlüğü ve giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemini açıkça aynı dalda sıralar. Sağlanan çerçeve bu adlandırmaları tek nesneye indirgemeden koruduğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, giysi ve korunma nesnesi adları ile giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemini kapsar; fiziksel kesme yalnız giysinin biçimini açıklayan arka plandır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda tanıklanan giysi, zırh ve kalkan adlarını temel alır; giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemi kaynakta verilen türemiş kullanım olarak ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Kadının giydiği zırh veya giysi, kesilmiş bir üstlük ya da savunmada kullanılan kalkan için kullanılan ad. Buna bağlı eylem, bir giysiyi bedene geçirip giymektir.

facets.statement: Kadının bedenine giydiği zırh veya koruyucu nitelikli giysi adı.
Aynı adın elde taşınan savunma aracı olan kalkanı belirtmesi ayrı bir nesne değeridir.
Kesilmiş bir tür üstlüğü belirtmesi, giysi alanındaki özel adlandırmadır.
Bir gömleği veya başka giysiyi bedene geçirip giymek, nesne adından ayrılan eylem kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kadın giysisi veya zırhı ile kalkanı ayrı nesne değerleri olarak verir; kesilmiş üstlük anlamı giysi alanını özelleştirir, giysiyi bedene geçirme ise eylem uzantısıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü öne eğilmiş ayakta duruşu, elleri dizlere koymayı, dizler üzerinde yüzüstü kapanmayı ve yere kapanmayı birlikte verir. Toplanma ise bağımsız bir toplama eylemi değil, bedenin bükülüp kendi üzerine çekilmesini açıklayan yön olarak anlaşılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bedensel duruş ve kapanmayla sınırlıdır; mal, su veya başka nesneleri toplama anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın duruş ve kapanma anlamlarını korur; bedensel toparlanma açıklamasını nesne toplama anlamına genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Ayaktayken gövdeyi öne eğip elleri dizlere koymak veya dizler üzerinde yüzüstü yere kapanmaktır. Her iki durumda da beden dik ve açık duruştan bükülmüş, kendi üzerine toplanmış bir duruşa geçer.

facets.statement: Ayakta gövdeyi öne eğmek ve elleri dizlerin üzerine koymak.
Dizler üzerinde yüzüstü kapanmak ya da yere kapanmak.
Bükülme sırasında bedenin kendi üzerine çekilip toparlanması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu anlatım, öne eğilmiş ayakta duruş ile diz çöküp yüzüstü kapanmayı aynı bedensel bükülme alanında birleştirir ve bu kapanmayı bedenin toparlanmasıyla açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın olgunlaşma öncesi ürün işlemi çekirdeği doğrudur, fakat geçici çerçeve yalnızca satıcının eylemini verir. Kaynak sözü aynı işlemi hem ürünün satılması hem de alıcının ürünü satın alması açısından anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım, ürünü olgunluğu belli olmadan alıp satma işleminin iki tarafını kapsar; genel ürün ticaretine yayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel ürün işlemini ve ona bağlı uyarı sözünü ayırır; buradan yalın köke genel bir satın alma veya satma anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Ekin veya tarla ürününü olgunlaşıp işe yarar duruma geldiği belli olmadan satmak ya da satın almaktır. Bu erken işlem, onu yapanın yasak kazanca girdiğini bildiren bir uyarı sözüyle kınanır.

facets.statement: Ekin veya tarla ürününü olgunluğu belli olmadan alım satıma konu etmek.
Aynı erken ürün işlemini kimi anlatımlarda satıcının, kimilerinde alıcının açısından vermek.
Bu işlemi yapanın yasak kazanca girdiğini bildiren uyarı sözü.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, ekin ya da tarla ürününün olgunluğu belli olmadan işleme sokulmasında birleşir; anlatımlar işlemi satıcı veya alıcı açısından verir ve bunu yasak kazançla ilişkilendiren uyarıyı aktarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalda temel olarak bir seyi kesmeyi, ozellikle de kokunden ayirip koparmayi verir. Deve horgucunun kokunden kesilmesi ve igdis edilmis kisinin organlarinin alinmasi bu cekirdegin ozel uygulamalari olarak ayni sinir icinde kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Duyusal kesip ayirma cekirdektir; korkak adam ya da ayri kap anlamlari bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem yalın kesme adi hem de horguc ve igdis etme baglamlari vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir kokten kesme ekseninde ayirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyi bulundugu kokten veya taban bagindan keserek ayirma, yok etme ya da bu kesilmis halde bulunma anlamidir.

facets.statement: Temel hareket, nesneyi kokunden veya asil bagindan kesip ayirmaktir.
Horgucun kokunden alinmasi ve igdis etmede organlarin alinmasi bu kesmenin beden uzerindeki ozel kullanimlaridir.
Kesme eyleminin sonucu olarak kesilmis horguclu hayvan veya kesilmis kisi nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak bicimde kesme anlamini verir ve bunu kokunden koparma sinirina tasir. Horgucun kesilmesi, her sey icin kesip ayirma fiili ve igdis edilmis kisi ornekleri ayni fiziksel ayirma cekirdegini destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel kesme cekirdegini ve horguc ya da beden organi gibi kokten koparma uygulamalarini birlikte karsilar.

error_profile.preserves: Kok bagindan kesme, ayirma ve kesilmis sonucun hepsini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesme sonucunda ortaya cikan durumu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dogrudan birini veya toplulugu ustun gelerek asmayi verir; guzellikte baskin cikma bunun belirgin bir kullanimidir. Kesme imgesi burada fiziksel degil, benzeriyle ayni duzeyde olma bagini koparan mecazi ustunluk olarak kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel kesmeye degil, kisinin veya toplulugun denklerini geride birakan ustunluguna aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Topluluğa karsi ustun gelme ve kadinin guzellikle diger kadinlari gecmesi birlikte verilir; tanim bu baglamlari genellestirir ama fiziksel kesmeye tasimaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin ya da seyin denklerini ustunlukla geride birakmasi, ozellikle guzellik veya baska bir nitelikle onlari asmasi anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, rakip veya denk sayilan kisileri ustun gelerek asmadir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali ustun gelme anlaminda birlestirir. Bazilari bunu guzellikte baskin cikma ornegiyle, bazilari da topluluga karsi galip olma ifadesiyle verir; fiziksel kesme yalniz mecazi aciklama olarak kalir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bedeni icine alan ve uzerinde tasinan giysidir.
Ayni ad koruyucu bir zırh icin de kullanilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar giyilen nesneyi ortak kabul eder ve onun bedeni sarmasi aciklamasini verir. Ek olarak zırh adi olarak kullanilmasi, giysi cekirdeginin koruyucu bir alt turu gibi belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Giyilen ana nesne ve zırh adi olarak koruyucu giysi kullanimi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bedeni icine alma, giyilme ve zırh alt turunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gundelik giyim nesnesi olarak aktarimda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Giyilen ve bedeni saran nesne anlamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Zırh adi olarak kullanimi bu ifade icinde acikca gorunmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Koruyucu savas giysisi anlamindaki ozel kullanim icindir.

error_profile.preserves: Koruyucu giyilebilir nesne alt anlamini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda nesne giyilir ve bedeni sarar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda bir sey icine giren yuva veya bosluk anlatilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de icine alma ve sarma goruntusuyle temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedene giyilen nesneyi anlatir; komsu dal mızrak ucu, goz, ev veya boynuz gibi yerlerdeki giris boslugunu anlatir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar giysi, sarma ve ic bosluk alanlarina yakindir; en yararli sinir giysi ile giris yuvasi arasindadir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجبة التي تلبس، وجمعها جباب وجبب، وما سمي من الدروع جبة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه تجاويف الرمح والعين والدار إلا من جهة صورة الدخول والاشتمال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبة معروفة لأنها تشمل الجسم وتجمعه فيها (maqayis)؛ الجباب جمع الجبة التي تلبس (ayn)؛ الجباب التي تلبس (sihah)؛ الجبة التي تلبس والجبة من أسماء الدروع (tahdhib)؛ الجبة التي هي اللباس منه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mızrak ucuna giren sap yuvasi, goz cukuru, evin ortasi, hurma tomurcugunun ici ve boynuzdaki yer gibi icine girilen veya icte kalan yerleri birlikte verir. Bu, bagimsiz kuyu ya da giyilen giysi degil, belirli nesnelerdeki giris veya ic bosluk adidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli nesne icindeki yuva ve ic boslukla sinirlidir; kuyu ve giysi dallari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Cok sayida tamlama ve bir form kullanimi vardir; tanim yalın genel bosluk degil bu baglamlardaki giris yerlerini ayirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin baska bir seyin icine girdigi yuva ya da goz, ev, tomurcuk ve boynuz gibi yapilarda icte kalan bolum anlamidir.

facets.statement: Temel ortaklik, bir seyin icine girdigi veya icte kaldigi bosluk ve yuva olmasidir.
Mızrak ucuna sapin girdigi yer en belirgin teknik kullanimdir.
Goz cukuru, evin ortasi, tomurcugun ici ve boynuzdaki yer ayni ic bolum tasavvuruyla kullanilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar mızrak ucu yuvasi etrafinda ortaklasir ve bunu icine girilen yer olarak aciklar. Tek kaynakli ek ornekler goz, ev, hurma tomurcugu ve boynuzdaki ic bolumleri ayni sekle baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Mızrak ucu yuvasi ve benzer ic bolumler icin kisa, genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Giris yeri, ic bosluk ve baglama gore ic bolum anlamlarini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Silah parcasinda sapin girdigi yer anlatildiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Teknik giris yuvasi anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Goz, ev, tomurcuk veya boynuz gibi nesnelerdeki ic kisim aktariminda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Icte kalan bolum anlamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Mızrak ucuna giren teknik yuva ayrintisi gorunmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nesne icindeki yuva veya ic kisimdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuyu dali yeryuzunde acilmis su cukurunu anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de ic bosluk ve derinlik tasavvuruyla temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal mızrak ucu, goz veya ev gibi bir nesnenin ic bolumunu anlatir; komsu dal bagimsiz bir kuyu adidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar oyuk, ic bolum, kuyu ve giysi alanlarina dagilir; en belirgin okur karisikligi ic yuva ile kuyu arasindadir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جبة السنان أو الرمح، وحجاج العين، ووسط الدار، وداخل طلعة، وجب القرن، وكل موضع مصور كجوف يدخل فيه شيء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه البئر المستقلة ولا اللباس، وإن اشتركت في صورة الجوف أو الاشتمال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبة ما دخل فيه ثعلب الرمح من السنان (maqayis)؛ جبة السنان أي مدخله (ayn)؛ الجبة ما دخل فيه الرمح من السنان (sihah)؛ جبة العين حجاجها وجبة الدار وسطها وجب طلعة داخلها وجب القرن الذي فيه المشاشة (tahdhib)؛ به شبه ما دخل فيه الرمح من السنان (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deri parcalardan yapilan toprak tasima sepetini ve et, parca et veya eritilmis yag konan iskembe turu kabi birlikte verir. Ses veya iri yanlilik anlamlari acikca bu kapsamin disinda tutulmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tasima ya da saklama kabi olan deri veya iskembe nesnesidir; ses ve beden iriligi anlamlari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanim tamlama baglamina dayanmadan kap ve tasima nesnesi olarak kurulur.

concept_map.definition: Toprak tasimaya yarayan deri sepet ya da et, parca et ve eritilmis yag konan iskembe turu kap anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek ortaklik, malzeme koyulan ve tasinan deri veya iskembe kaynakli kap olmasidir.
Bir kullanimda toprak tasimak icin deriden yapilmis sepeti anlatir.
Baska kullanimda et, parca et veya eritilmis yag konan iskembe kabi anlatilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kap anlamini iki somut alanda verir: toprak tasiyan deri sepet ve yiyecek ya da yag konan iskembe kabi. Her iki kullanimda da nesne bir seyi icinde tutup tasimaya yarar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Toprak tasima sepeti ile yiyecek veya yag kabi anlamlarini ortak bir kap cekirdeginde karsilar.

error_profile.preserves: Deri sepet, iskembe kabi ve icinde malzeme bulundurma islevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toprak tasimak icin kullanilan deri kap anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Deri sepet ve toprak tasima islevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Et, parca et veya yag konulan iskembe kabi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yiyecek veya yag koyma islevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: et veya yag konan iskembe kabi
bu kaba et parcalari koymak veya ona gore hazirlanmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal deri sepet veya iskembe kabi gibi tasima ve saklama kaplarini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal parcalari dikilerek yapilmis su tulumunu anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da deri veya organ kaynakli kap alanina yakindir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal toprak, et ya da yag icin kullanilan kaplara aittir; komsu dal dikilmis su tulumu gibi belirli bir su kabi adidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Kap ve tasima komsulari coktur; yayinlanan ayrim ayni alan icindeki deri kap ile dikilmis su tulumu sinirini netlestirir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجبجبة بمعنى الزبيل من جلود ينقل فيه التراب، والكرش أو الوعاء الذي يجعل فيه اللحم أو الخلع أو الإهالة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجبجبة إذا أريد بها مجرد الصوت على رأي المفردات، ولا ضخامة الجنبين.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبجبة زبيل من جلود يجمع فيه التراب والجبجبة الكرش يجعل فيه اللحم (maqayis)؛ الجبجبة الكرش يجعل فيها الخلع أو تذاب الإهالة فتحقن فيها والجبجبة أيضا زبيل من جلود ينقل فيه التراب (sihah)؛ الجبجبة زبيل من جلود ينقل فيه التراب والجبجبة الكرش يجعل فيها اللحم ويسمى الخلع (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskin bolumu insanlarin hurmayi asılamasini ve bunun zamanini verir. Bir kaynakta zamanin hasat zamaniyla yaklastirilmasi bulunsa da dal yalniz genel kesme anlamina indirgenemez; tanim hurma isleri baglamina bagli kalmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hurma asilama isi ve mevsimiyle sinirlidir; genel kesme veya genel tarim zamani olarak genisletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam tamlama ve baglama baglidir; tanim hurma isini yalın kok anlamina cevirmeden verir.

concept_map.definition: Hurma agacini asılama isi ve bu isin yapildigi mevsim, kimi aktarimda hurma kesim zamaniyla iliskili zaman anlamidir.

facets.statement: Ana kullanim, insanlarin hurma agacini asılamasi eylemidir.
Ayni ad bu isin veya yakin hurma islerinin zamani icin kullanilir.
Bir aktarim zaman anlamini kesim zamaniyla yaklastirir, fakat dal hurma isleri baglaminda kalir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hurma asilama eylemini ve bunun zamani olarak kullanimi birlikte verir. Zamanin hurma kesim donemine yaklastirildigi aktarim, cekirdegi genis bir kesme anlamina degil hurma islerinin mevsimine baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hurma agaciyla ilgili bu ozel is ve onun mevsimi soz konusu oldugunda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Asılama eylemini, zaman anlamini ve hurma baglamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Insanlarin hurma agacina uyguladigi eylem anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma asilama eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zaman bildirimi olarak gecen kullanimlarda, asilama veya kesimle iliskili donemi aciklar.

error_profile.preserves: Zaman ve hurma isi baglamini korur.
error_profile.adds: Asilama ile kesim arasindaki kesin ayrimi gevsetir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: hurma asilama veya hurma isleri zamani

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hurma isine bagli asilama ve zaman adidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal genel kokten kesip ayirma eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi bazi aktarimlarda kesim zamani imgesiyle temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hurma agaci uzerindeki belirli tarim isine ve mevsime baglidir; komsu dal herhangi bir nesnenin kokunden kesilmesine aittir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular hurma, bitki cikisi ve kesme alanindadir; yayinlanan ayrim kollokasyon sinirini korumak icindir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جب الناس النخل، وزمن الجباب، حيث فسرت المصادر الفعل بتلقيح النخل أو جعلته زمنا من أعمال النخل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أصل القطع العام إلا حيث ربطه المفردات بزمن الصرام.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وجب الناس النخل إذا ألقحوه وذا زمن الجباب (maqayis)؛ الجباب أيضا تلقيح النخل وقد جب الناس النخل (sihah)؛ إذا لقح الناس النخيل قيل قد جبوا وقد أتانا زمن الجباب (tahdhib)؛ كجب النخل وقيل زمن الجباب نحو زمن الصرام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yeryuzunun sert ve kalin yuzunu, sert topragi ve koparilan iri toprak kesegini verir. Kuyu anlami burada yalniz kazilabilecek zeminle temas eder, dalin kendisi kuyu degildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sert ve kalin toprak yuzeyidir; kuyu veya su cukuru anlamina kaydirilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanim collocation baglamindan degil toprak yuzeyi adi olarak kurulur.

concept_map.definition: Yeryuzunun sert, kalin veya kaba toprakli yuzeyi ve bu yuzeyden koparilan iri toprak kesegi anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam sert, kalin veya kaba yeryuzu tabakasidir.
Bu yuzeyden koparilan iri toprak kesegi de ayni alana baglanir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sert veya kalin yeryuzu anlaminda ortaklasir; bazilari bunu dogrudan yuzey, bazilari kalin toprak olarak verir. Iri kesek aktarimi bu sert yuzeyden koparilan parcaya uzanir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yeryuzunun kaba ve sert tabakasi ile ondan kopan iri kesek icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sertlik, kalin toprak yuzeyi ve kesek uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yeryuzunun sert tabakasi anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sert yuzey ve yeryuzu anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yerden koparilan kaba kesek anlaminda kullanilir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal su icin acilmis kaplanmamis kuyu adidir.
